rows.note: Use this for a user's profile page or account section in a website or app.

example.english: You can edit your profile in Settings.
example.traditional: 你可以喺設定入面改個人檔案。
example.jyutping: nei5 ho2 ji5 hai2 cit3 ding6 jap6 min6 goi2 go3 jan4 dong2 on3

rows.note: Use this for the all-purpose noun meaning a person's head or face viewed from the side.

example.english: I managed to capture her profile in the photo.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jing2 dou2 keoi5 go3 zak1 min6

rows.note: Use this all-purpose expression for a collection or summary of information about a person.

example.english: You need to fill in your profile when completing the form.
example.traditional: 填表嗰陣要填個人資料。
example.jyutping: tin4 biu2 go2 zan6 jiu3 tin4 go3 jan4 zi1 liu2

rows.note: Use this when profile means how well-known or prominent a person or organization is in public life.

example.english: This show raised the singer's profile.
example.traditional: 呢個節目令個歌手知名度高咗。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zit3 muk6 ling6 go3 go1 sau2 zi1 meng2 dou6 gou1 zo2
